title: alnus alnobetula var. fruticosa
intro: Alnus alnobetula var. fruticosa, commonly known as Mountain Alder or Dwarf Mountain Alder, is a shrub-like variant of the Alnus alnobetula tree species. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, including its ability to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Alnus alnobetula var. fruticosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Regular consumption of Alnus alnobetula var. fruticosa is believed to promote overall health and wellness, thanks to its potential to reduce oxidative stress and improve immune function.
